# Yohaku Companion v1.8.4

## Highlights

- QQ Music and NetEase Cloud Music are now detected directly through built-in macOS media sessions, including when a browser owns the global Now Playing session.
- QQ Music album artwork can now be recovered from local queue, library, and AutoMix metadata when macOS omits the cover.
- Discord Rich Presence now uses a native Swift implementation of Discord's local IPC protocol. Development and release builds no longer require the proprietary Discord Social SDK archive or its embedded dynamic library.

## Fixes and reliability

- Preserved supported-player pause transitions instead of incorrectly reporting an active browser, while returning to browser media after the supported session disappears.
- Rejected stale QQ Music and NetEase Cloud Music session records after their application exits.
- Added bounded Discord framing, handshake validation, nonce correlation, timeout handling, reconnect behavior, PING/PONG responses, cancellation cleanup, and explicit Presence clearing.
- Avoided resolving the protected Yohaku Device Token while Live Desk is disabled.

## Update notes

- No Discord SDK setup step is required for development or release builds.
